2607.22525.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning for assisting Air Traffic Controllers
2607.22525.paper_summary: To effectively integrate AI into high-stakes, critical environments such as healthcare, autonomous driving, and aviation--and to advance toward higher levels of automation and seamless human-AI collaboration--building trust in AI-driven solutions is essential. Trust, in turn, is closely linked to the explainability of AI systems. The rapid advancements in AI across various domains have underscored the challenges of establishing trust, raising increasing interest in AI explainability even more when applied to deep learning. In this context, the present work aims to explore the application of explainability techniques to Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms, specifically within the safety-critical domain of Air Traffic Control (ATC). Using a simplified ATC environment as an initial testbed, an intelligent agent is trained with a reinforcement learning algorithm to make decisions on alternative flight routes that avoid no-fly zones. As a preliminary explainability approach, a saliency map is employed, providing insights into the input features that most significantly influence the agent's decision-making process.
2607.22525.paper_summary_zh: 為了有效地將人工智慧整合進入高風險、關鍵環境，例如醫療保健、自動駕駛和航空，並朝向更高層次的自動化和無縫的人機協作，建立對於人工智慧驅動解決方案的信任是至關重要的。信任反過來又與人工智慧系統的可解釋性密切相關。人工智慧在各個領域的快速進展凸顯了建立信任的挑戰，尤其是在應用於深度學習時，對於人工智慧可解釋性的興趣日益增加。在這個背景下，本研究旨在探索可解釋性技術在強化學習（RL）算法中的應用，特別是在航空交通管制（ATC）這一安全關鍵領域。使用簡化的ATC環境作為初步測試平台，訓練一個智能代理，利用強化學習算法做出避免禁飛區的替代航線決策。作為初步的可解釋性方法，採用了一個顯著性圖，提供了對於最顯著影響代理決策過程的輸入特徵的洞見。
